label: 128.90M USDai burned; issuer reports matching sUSDai loan deployment
note: Reviewed September 27, 2026: Arbitrum block 508237173 records 128,895,244.1 USDai burned by USD.AI's EscrowTimelock escrow-admin Safe and 128,895,243.0 PYUSD paid out of the canonical hub. The sUSDai vault had funded that Safe with exactly 128,895,244.1 USDai the same evening. The issuer dashboard at https://app.usd.ai/dashboard reports loan reserves rising from $272,340,412.885676 to $401,235,656.985676 between September 23 20:29:59 and 20:59:59 UTC, while protocol TVL stays near $609.05M. Base-token supply genuinely contracted; the matched deployment does not establish investor withdrawal. Mint/burn flow methodology v6.21 excludes this event from counted flow. This does not attribute every burn or the entire weekly net supply change to deployment.
